paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates a generation length comparison for the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B model across four benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis displays the categories in the following order: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, without an overarching axis label. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Generation Length (words)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 8000 with numeric tick labels evenly spaced at intervals of 1000, supplemented by horizontal dashed grid lines. The data is visualized using grouped vertical bars, where each category features two side-by-side bars whose meanings are defined by a top-center legend. Within each group, the left bar is colored light pink and represents "Vanilla CoT", while the right bar is dark red and represents "TLDR (Ours)". The categories are not strictly sorted by height, but visual emphasis is provided through specific text annotations placed above the bars. Specifically, all light pink "Vanilla CoT" bars are annotated with exact numeric values in black text, whereas all dark red "TLDR (Ours)" bars are annotated with negative percentage values in red text. The shortest bars appear in the GSM8K group, where the light pink bar has an annotated value of 679 and the paired dark red bar is visually shorter with a label of "-65%". The tallest bars are found in the AIME group, with the light pink bar reaching a value of 6701 and the corresponding dark red bar annotated with "-4%". In the intermediate groups, the MATH500 category features a light pink bar at 2951 paired with a dark red bar labeled "-31%", and the AMC category shows a light pink bar at 4584 paired with a dark red bar labeled "-16%".
